clear; cd /app
gen() { # $1 = number of pointers
  local n=$1
  local loop=$((n*2))
  local off0=$loop
  {
  echo ";redcode-94"
  echo ";name Bom$1"
  echo "        org start"
  echo "start"
  local i
  for ((i=0;i<n;i++)); do
    local addoff=$((off0 + i - i))  # pointer i at offset loop+i
    # add #4, (loop+i) - i  => target = i + (loop+i-i) = loop+i
    echo "        add #4, $((loop+i-i))"
    # mov at offset i+1: source = (i+1)+(loop+i-(i+1)) = loop+i ; same for @
    echo "        mov $((loop+i-(i+1))), @$((loop+i-(i+1)))"
  done
  echo "        jmp -$loop"
  for ((i=0;i<n;i++)); do echo "        dat #0, #0"; done
  echo "        end"
  }
}
for n in 1 2 3; do
  gen $n > scratch/bom_$n.red
  echo "=== n=$n ==="; cat scratch/bom_$n.red
  ./scratch/test_all.sh scratch/bom_$n.red
done

#!/bin/bash
# usage: t.sh <warrior>  -> shows W and PASS/FAIL per opponent
W="$1"
declare -A REQ=( [stone]=75 [paper]=75 [vampire]=75 [snake]=33 [g2-clear]=33 )
allpass=1
for opp in stone paper vampire snake g2-clear; do
  line=$(pmars -b -r 100 -f "$W" "warriors/$opp.red" 2>/dev/null | grep '^Results:')
  read -r _ W L D <<< "$line"
  req=${REQ[$opp]}
  if [ "$W" -ge "$req" ]; then st=PASS; else st=FAIL; allpass=0; fi
  printf "%-10s W=%-3s L=%-3s D=%-3s (need %s) %s\n" "$opp" "$W" "$L" "$D" "$req" "$st"
done
[ $allpass -eq 1 ] && echo ">>> ALL PASS <<<" || echo ">>> NOT ALL PASS <<<"
EOF
chmod +x scratch/t.sh
./scratch/t.sh scratch/n2.red
